# v0.11.5 — Labyrinth image-model asset pass

This release replaces the simplified labyrinth guide art with a complete semi-realistic, hand-painted fantasy RPG asset set.

## Style

- enchanted forest ruins;
- warm storybook colors;
- mossy stone, roots, foliage, and soft magical light;
- clear isometric silhouettes suitable for mobile displays;
- child-friendly monsters and guardian;
- transparent sprite and tile canvases;
- opaque map and encounter backdrops.

## Generated files

The pass covers every labyrinth image used by v0.11.4:

- three floor tiles;
- sixteen route tiles;
- fog and four wall orientations;
- hero, dragon, and entrance;
- four rune shrines;
- three monsters and one guardian;
- four traps;
- closed/open cache and treasure states;
- healing fountain and reveal obelisk;
- six room decorations;
- map and encounter backdrops.

## Source and extraction

The original 1536 × 1024 generated atlas is retained at:

```text
asset-packs/cc0-pixel-v10/sources/labyrinth-ai-v0115/labyrinth-ai-atlas.png
```

The deterministic extraction utility is:

```text
tools/extract-labyrinth-ai-atlas.py
```

Run:

```bash
npm run assets:extract-labyrinth-ai
```

The script crops each item, removes the dark atlas background, filters label fragments, normalizes transparency, and fits the result to the exact game canvas.

## Review note

The route files keep the `path-00` through `path-15` names and expected canvas sizes. Because image models can subtly alter route geometry, visually review adjoining route combinations before treating the art as final production material.
